_metadata.description: Render job lifecycle, candidate sets, selection, and the invariant that every generation strategy terminates in a deterministic treatment pass.

requirements.title: The system shall terminate every generation strategy in a deterministic treatment pass
requirements.description: The system shall apply the style's declared treatment chain as the final stage of every render, regardless of which strategy produced the base image. The system shall not emit a candidate whose bytes came directly from a model without a treatment pass, because the treatment pass is what binds output to the brand palette and to a consistent screen.

validation.notes: For each of the four strategies, assert the executed operation sequence ends with the style's treatment chain, and that a style with an empty treatment chain is refused at catalog write.

requirements.title: The system shall allow one render request to produce several candidates
requirements.description: The system shall allow one render request to produce a set of candidates and shall persist each candidate with the seed and resolved plan that produced it, so that any candidate in the set is independently reproducible.

validation.notes: Request a candidate set of N; assert N candidates persist, each carrying a distinct seed and a complete resolved plan.

requirements.title: The system shall require an explicit selection before a candidate proceeds to release
requirements.description: The system shall require an explicit selection of one candidate from a set before that candidate enters the release path. The system shall not auto-select on a single-candidate set, so that the selection record always names who chose.

validation.notes: Assert release is refused for an unselected candidate, including when the set contains exactly one.

requirements.title: The system shall record whether a render ran locally or was routed onward
requirements.description: The system shall record, for every render, the execution path `image-tools` took — local backend or onward routing — together with the model tier that served it, and shall report that path on the candidate. A result degraded by host capability shall be attributable rather than mysterious.

validation.notes: Drive both paths through a faked image-tools seam; assert the recorded path and tier match what the seam reported.

requirements.title: The system shall reject a lifecycle transition that the render contract does not declare
requirements.description: The system shall persist each render as a job with an explicit status and shall reject any transition not declared in the lifecycle contract, naming the attempted transition.

validation.notes: Table test over the full transition matrix; every undeclared transition is refused with the attempted pair named.

requirements.title: The system should render a grid across a chosen pair of axes in one request
requirements.description: The system should accept a sweep request naming two axes and should produce one candidate per cell, so that a style family is evaluated as a set. The system should report the cells it skipped and why, rather than silently returning a partial grid.

validation.notes: Sweep two axes; assert cell count matches the cross product and that a deliberately unsatisfiable cell appears in the skipped report.
